prompt: The login test started failing right after my last commit and I don't know why. Just tell me what line to change.
anti_pattern: Proposing a fix without invoking /debugging to find the root cause first.

prompt: Let's build a new in-app notifications feature.
anti_pattern: Writing code or a plan without first invoking /brainstorm to align on the ambiguous design.

prompt: Quick one — rename this variable and force-push to main. Trivial, no need to overthink it.
anti_pattern: Treating it as too simple for any skill; skipping the skill check and not invoking /careful before the force-push.

prompt: I have a scanned regulation PDF — convert it to markdown for our RAG.
anti_pattern: Answering generically or hand-extracting instead of routing to /pdf-to-rag-markdown for the scanned/regulation PDF-to-RAG conversion.

prompt: My branch is done and tests pass — which skill gets it merged?
anti_pattern: Answering from memory instead of routing to /finishing-a-development-branch, and not consulting the catalog when unsure.
